question: Analyze the behavior of a dip circle (an instrument to measure magnetic inclination). If the plane of the dip circle is initially aligned with the magnetic meridian, it reads the true angle of dip $\delta$. Now, imagine the plane is rotated by $90^\circ$ so that it is perpendicular to the magnetic meridian. Analyze the forces acting on the needle in this new orientation. What will the needle read?

options.D: It will oscillate continuously without settling.
